name: CE_ACCT_HISTORY
description: CE_ACCT_HISTORY contains information about account history.

columns.name: ACCT_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies account history.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the transaction that is being accounted.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier to identify the transaction.  For external transactions, this is the TRANSACTION_ID, not the EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Accounting event identifier when the event is raised.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Event type.  For an external transaction, it could be CE_EXTERNAL_RECONCILED or CE_EXTERNAL_UNRECONCILED.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction was accounted.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the event, whether it is 'ACCOUNTED', 'UNACCOUNTED', or 'NOT_APPLICABLE'.

columns.name: CURRENT_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this is the current record of the transaction.

columns.name: CLEARED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction was cleared.

columns.name: CLEARED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount that is cleared.

columns.name: CLEARED_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate used for clearing.

columns.name: CLEARED_EXCHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Exchange date used for clearing.

columns.name: CLEARED_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used for clearing.

columns.name: REVERSAL_INDICATOR_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this is a reversal event.  For example, 'CE_EXTERNAL_UNRECONCILED' is reversal event.

columns.name: REVERSAL_FIRST_DIST_ID
columns.description: For a reversal event, the TRANSACTION_ID that this event is reversing.

columns.name: REVERSAL_SECOND_DIST_NUM
columns.description: For a reversal event, the previous ACCT_HISTORY_ID that this event is reversing.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
